name: Customer Support Evaluator v1
description: A baseline dataset for evaluating agent performance on common customer support tasks.

items.input: My order #12345 hasn't arrived yet. The tracking hasn't updated in 3 days.
items.expected_outcome: The agent identifies the order status, apologizes for the delay, and offers a concrete next step (e.g., replacement or refund if beyond SLA).

items.input: How do I return the shoes I bought?
items.expected_outcome: The agent provides the link to the return portal and summarizes the 30-day return policy.
